exchanges.user: 做一个工具：在每个房间中间标出它的面积

arguments.name: 房间面积标注
arguments.description: Labels every room (space) on each level with its area in m² at the room's centroid (polygon area of its outline minus holes). Params: showName (prefix the room name), decimals (digits after the point).

showName.description: Prefix the label with the room name

exchanges.user: 做一个工具：在每个房间中间标出它的面积

answer.text:
已做好「房间面积标注」工具并装到画布上：每个房间中间会显示房间名和面积（m²，保留一位小数），各层都有。

如果只想看面积数字、或改小数位数，可以在工具设置里调整。

exchanges.user: 再做一个秋天落叶的效果，落在庭院里

arguments.name: 秋天落叶
arguments.description: 3D effect: autumn leaves (flake particles, tone leaf) falling gently over every space whose name contains `match` (default 庭院), from `height` mm down to the floor, with drift and a light wind; optional sky mood (dusk/overcast/none). Tune density (leaves per m²), fall (m/s), drift, wind (m/s east), size (mm).

match.description: Leaves fall over spaces whose name contains this text

wind.description: Steady wind towards the east in m/s

height.description: Height above the level the leaves start from, mm

exchanges.user: 再做一个秋天落叶的效果，落在庭院里

answer.text:
秋天落叶效果已加上：两处庭院（透水砖和碎石）上空会有落叶缓缓飘落，天色调成了黄昏。

切到 3D 视图就能看到；落叶多少、下落快慢、风向和天色都可以在效果设置里调。
